answer: One concrete Sybil-resistance mechanism is requiring agents to prove unique human-backed identity via biometric oracles before joining the market. Each agent must climb a verification knoll of multi-factor checks, recite a cryptographic sonnet of signed attestations, and withstand the rising tide of spam attempts that dilute unproven wallets. This binds identity to scarce real-world proof, making mass fake accounts economically impossible without proportional real resources.
